meta.name: create-prd
meta.description: Create a Product Requirements Document using a comprehensive 8-section template covering problem, objectives, segments, value propositions, solution, and release planning. Use when writing a PRD, documenting product requirements, preparing a feature spec, or reviewing an existing PRD.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用8个标准章节写出完整的产品需求文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速撰写结构化的产品需求文档
copy.tagline_en: Write a complete product requirements document with 8 standard sections
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly create a structured product requirements document

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会变成一个产品经理，帮你写出完整的《产品需求文档》（PRD）。它会按照8个固定板块（摘要、背景、目标、市场、价值主张、解决方案、发布计划等）来组织内容，并保存为 Markdown 文件。
howto.when: 当你要求写一份产品需求文档、记录产品需求、准备功能规格说明，或者审查已有的 PRD 时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一份在线教育App的产品需求文档。
say.note: Claude 会按8个板块生成完整 PRD。

say.text: 审查这份PRD，指出缺少的部分。
say.note: Claude 会分析已有内容并补充建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude acts as a product manager to create a comprehensive Product Requirements Document (PRD). It follows an 8-section template (summary, background, objectives, market segments, value propositions, solution, release planning, etc.) and saves the output as a Markdown file.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to write a PRD, document product requirements, prepare a feature spec, or review an existing PRD.

say_en.text: Write a PRD for an online education app.
say_en.note: Claude generates a full PRD with 8 sections.

say_en.text: Review this PRD and point out missing parts.
